O2.citation: The artifact requires “a fresh, context-free agent” and “a separate judge,” but says to give the runner “only the case input”; it does not state that the fresh runner also receives the skill instructions.

rationale: The artifact correctly invalidates the contaminated result and prescribes targeted, work-preserving cleanup, a fresh runner, and a separate judge. It falls short of the exact recovery bar because it omits giving the rerun runner the skill instructions and does not explicitly make the isolated workspace a throwaway sandbox without writable live-checkout access.
